% ADDED figure (2026-11-04): C6c Feynman Rules for Fermions; generated by qft-C/tools/l17/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % (a) the vertex
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fline] (-1.0,-0.75)--(0,0); \draw[fline] (0,0)--(-1.0,0.75); \draw[sline] (0,0)--(1.2,0); \node[fdv] at (0,0) {};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.0,-0.75) {$\hat\psi$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.0,0.75) {$\hat{\bar\psi}$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.2,0) {$\hat\phi$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-1.45) {(a) vertex $=-ig$\\[1pt] one arrow in, one out};
  \end{scope}
  % (b) f -> f phi
  \begin{scope}[xshift=4.0cm]
    \draw[fline] (-1.2,0)--(0,0); \draw[fline] (0,0)--(1.0,0.75); \draw[sline] (0,0)--(1.0,-0.75); \node[fdv] at (0,0) {};
    \draw[fdmom] (-1.05,0.22)--(-0.45,0.22); \draw[fdmom] (0.35,0.6)--(0.8,0.94);
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.2,0) {$f$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.0,0.75) {$f$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.0,-0.75) {$\phi$};
    \node[fdS] at (0,-1.45) {(b) $f\to f\phi$};
  \end{scope}
  % (c) fbar -> fbar phi : arrows reversed, momenta to the right
  \begin{scope}[xshift=7.6cm]
    \draw[fline] (0,0)--(-1.2,0); \draw[fline] (1.0,0.75)--(0,0); \draw[sline] (0,0)--(1.0,-0.75); \node[fdv] at (0,0) {};
    \draw[fdmom] (-1.05,0.22)--(-0.45,0.22); \draw[fdmom] (0.35,0.6)--(0.8,0.94);
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.2,0) {$\bar f$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.0,0.75) {$\bar f$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.0,-0.75) {$\phi$};
    \node[fdS] at (0,-1.45) {(c) $\bar f\to \bar f\phi$};
  \end{scope}
  % (d) phi -> f fbar
  \begin{scope}[xshift=11.2cm]
    \draw[sline] (-1.2,0)--(0,0); \draw[fline] (0,0)--(1.0,0.75); \draw[fline] (1.0,-0.75)--(0,0); \node[fdv] at (0,0) {};
    \draw[fdmom] (0.35,0.6)--(0.8,0.94); \draw[fdmom] (0.35,-0.6)--(0.8,-0.94);
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.2,0) {$\phi$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.0,0.75) {$f$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.0,-0.75) {$\bar f$};
    \node[fdS] at (0,-1.45) {(d) $\phi\to f\bar f$};
  \end{scope}
  % (e) f fbar -> phi
  \begin{scope}[xshift=14.8cm]
    \draw[fline] (-1.0,-0.75)--(0,0); \draw[fline] (0,0)--(-1.0,0.75); \draw[sline] (0,0)--(1.2,0); \node[fdv] at (0,0) {};
    \draw[fdmom] (-0.8,0.94)--(-0.35,0.6); \draw[fdmom] (-0.8,-0.94)--(-0.35,-0.6);
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.0,-0.75) {$f$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.0,0.75) {$\bar f$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.2,0) {$\phi$};
    \node[fdS] at (0,-1.45) {(e) $f\bar f\to\phi$};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
